BL-1569 — test_operator_runtime_hotfix_certification_sweep.sh is red on main with no owner: the fixture's sandbox copy of swarm_handoff.bb cannot load because both load-file closure walkers (bb_load_closure_lib.bb and its JS twin) capture only the last string of a multi-segment load-file and drop the directory, and copy_bb_closure silently skips a member it cannot find - unregistered_test_gate_lib.bb's test/suite_inventory_lib.bb (62109c3f75) never reaches the sandbox, the coordinator nudge throws FileNotFoundException, and the BL-897 agreement gate passes because both twins agree on the wrong answer
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: both walkers keep emitting bare filenames for single-segment load-files (every existing consumer copies those by name into a flat dir) and emit the directory-qualified relative path onl…
BL-1569 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1569" (or "reject BL-1569 <reason>") to act.
